gloss: Warm Biz; winter energy-saving dress campaign

definitions.gloss: Warm Biz; winter energy-saving dress campaign
definitions.explanation: A Japanese government-led campaign encouraging warm, layered clothing in winter so that office heating can be set lower to save energy.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}でウォームビズを{始|はじ}めた。
ウォームビズで{暖房|だんぼう}の{設定|せってい}{温度|おんど}を{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: We lowered the heating temperature as part of Warm Biz.

examples.japanese: ウォームビズの{一環|いっかん}として、{社員|しゃいん}はセーターを{着|き}て{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: As part of Warm Biz, employees work wearing sweaters.

notes:
A winter counterpart to クールビズ (Cool Biz), promoted by the Japanese government from 2005 to reduce heating energy use. Workers wear warmer clothes so offices can keep the thermostat lower (around 20°C).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウォームビズを{実施|じっし}する: to carry out Warm Biz
- ウォームビズ{期間|きかん}: the Warm Biz period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クールビズ: Cool Biz — the summer version, encouraging light dress so cooling can be reduced
